def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    
    # Build node map and children map
    node_map = {}
    children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        node_map[node['id']] = node
        children[node['id']] = []
    for node in nodes:
        parent = node['parent']
        if parent is not None:
            children[parent].append(node['id'])
    
    # Precompute subtree symbols via DFS (post-order)
    subtree_symbols = {}
    def dfs(node_id):
        node = node_map[node_id]
        sym_set = {node['symbol']}
        for child_id in children[node_id]:
            sym_set |= dfs(child_id)
        subtree_symbols[node_id] = sym_set
        return sym_set
    # Start from root (parent None)
    root_id = None
    for node in nodes:
        if node['parent'] is None:
            root_id = node['id']
            break
    dfs(root_id)  # ensures all nodes visited
    
    # Initial retained set (all nodes)
    retained = set(node['id'] for node in nodes)
    removed = []
    
    # Sort nodes by depth descending, then node ID ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node['id']
        if nid == root_id:
            continue
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        if node['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # Check retained children: any child still in retained?

        # Check if removing this node would lose a required symbol in its subtree
        if subtree_symbols[nid] & required_symbols:
            continue
        # Remove
        removed.append(nid)
        retained.discard(nid)
    
    # Sort retained IDs
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed, "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted}
